reply: The data show the rate is driven mostly by t (corr 0.85 with dP/dt), and the largest rates occur at low P and high t. Linear searches over product-form libraries never fit well, and the last variant I tried, which added a 1/P term, was worse. I used 13 of the 14 tool calls and have one left, unused.

best.code:
def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*P*np.log(P) + params[1]*t*np.log(P) + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*t*P + params[4]*t**params[5] + params[6]*np.log(1+P)**2*np.log(1+params[7]*t)**2 + params[8]*np.log(1+t)**2 + params[9]*P
